name: Sea Captain, Experienced (CR 8)
body:
SEA CAPTAIN, EXPERIENCED
CR 8

Human valkyrie (vala) 7/champion 3
NG medium humanoid (human)
Init +5, amazing initiative; Senses Perception +11
Aura courage (10 ft.)

DEFENSE

AC 22, touch 12, flat-footed 20 (+9 armor, +2 Dex, +1 shield), -2 while raging hp 79 (7d10+21+15)
Fort +8, Ref +5, Will +7; +2 Will when in a rage
Defensive Abilities battle training, hard to kill, improved battle training, recuperation; Resist 5/acid and cold while raging or vanquishing (celestial blood)

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee +1 planar broadsword +12/+7 (2d4+5), good-aligned and +1d6 vs. evil outsiders while vanquishing, +14/+9 (2d4+7, good-aligned, +1d6 vs. evil outsiders) while raging
Ranged composite shortbow +9/+4 (1d6+4/x3)
Special Attacks destroyer, flash of rage, mythic power 9/day, mythic rage, rage 7 round/day, rage powers (celestial blood, lesser celestial blood) surge +1d6, sudden attack, vanquish foe 3/day (+2 attack, +7 damage) Vala Spells Known (CL 4th; concentration +6)

2nd Level (2/day)—instant armor, paladin’s sacrifice, rage*, spiritual weapon
1st Level (2/day)—challenge evil (DC 13), divine favor, stalwart resolve, unseen servant, word of resolve

Mystery Ancestor

STATISTICS

Str 18, Dex 14, Con 14,, Int 12,, Wis 12, Cha 14
Base Atk +7; CMB +12; CMD 23
Traits Bred for War, Call of the Longships
Feats Power AttackM, Toughness, Vala’s Curse*, Vala’s Magic, Weapon Focus M (broadsword)
Skills Acrobatics +12, Intimidate +13, Perception +11, Profession (sailor) +9, Survival +11, Swim +14
Languages Common, Northern Common
SQ oracle’s curse (wrath), revelation (wisdom of the ancestors 1/day, divination, 80%)
Gear belt of incredible dexterity +2 (4,000 gp), composite shortbow (+4) (375 gp) with 20 arrows (1 gp), +3 chainmail (9,300 gp), light steel shield (9 gp), +1 planar broadsword (8,320 gp), ring of resistance +1 (1,500 gp), valkyrie’s kit (10 gp)
